judge.rationale: The candidate completely forgot to edit `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts` to move the `beforeSession` call inside the `try` block, as even shown by the unchecked box in its own `.lore/dod.md`. Because the core bug fix was never applied, the newly added tests in `src/orchestration/chatHooks.acceptance.test.ts` will fail. Additionally, the update to `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md` fails to answer the explicit ticket requirement to state what `afterSession` can assume about how much of the turn happened when `beforeSession` throws. Finally, the candidate left behind the `.lore/dod.md` scratchpad file and created a separate test file instead of adding to `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts`.
